milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because 'find' tasks require the player to navigate near the target and visually observe it. The bee_nest is at spawn-relative (6, 2, 6) on the south face of the oak tree. max_distance=16 allows the player to 'find' it from a reasonable viewing distance (the bee_nest is clearly visible from ~10 blocks away per sandbox verification). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the bee_nest, confirming visual discovery rather than coincidental proximity.

Uses inventory_has because mining bamboo drops a bamboo item that ends up in the player's inventory. This is the preferred rule type for mine tasks — directly checking that the player obtained the mined resource. Bamboo breaks instantly with any tool or bare hands and drops itself as an item. min_count=1 requires at least one bamboo to be collected, confirming the player successfully broke and picked up bamboo from the grove.
